en.title: Freya Allan Trades Witcher's Continent for London's Underground in New Horror Flick
en.summary: The Witcher's breakout star Freya Allan is diving into the dark, abandoned tunnels beneath London for a chilling new horror project. Details are scarce, but the actress is set to lead the mysterious film titled 'System'.
en.body:
The world of **Freya Allan** is expanding beyond the Continent. Known globally for her captivating portrayal of Princess Cirilla of Cintra in Netflix's **The Witcher**, Allan is now set to headline a new horror film titled **System**. Directed by **Joachim Rønning**, the project promises a descent into the terrifying unknown, with production already underway in the atmospheric, abandoned underground stations and tunnels of London.

While plot details for **System** remain shrouded in secrecy, its subterranean setting and the involvement of Rønning, who previously directed **Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales**, suggest a visually striking and suspenseful experience. Allan will be joined by **Denzel Baidoo**, an actor gaining recognition for his role in **The Witcher** alongside her. The combination of a rising star and a seasoned director in a genre ripe for atmospheric storytelling has certainly piqued our interest.

## A New Genre for a Rising Star

Allan's journey in the entertainment industry has been meteoric. Her role as the fiercely determined Princess Ciri in **The Witcher** has cemented her status as a fan favorite, showcasing her ability to handle demanding action sequences and complex emotional arcs. This foray into horror marks a significant genre pivot for the young actress. While specific plot points for **System** are under wraps, the very nature of its reported filming location – the labyrinthine, forgotten spaces beneath a major city – hints at a story that could leverage claustrophobia and the psychological toll of isolation. Allan's proven talent for conveying vulnerability and resilience will undoubtedly be put to the test in this new, darker landscape.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans eagerly awaiting Allan's next move after **The Witcher** saga winds down, **System** offers a tantalizing glimpse into her evolving career. The series is confirmed to conclude with its fifth season, with Allan reprising her role as Ciri. This new horror venture suggests she is keen to explore a wider range of characters and narratives, demonstrating a versatility that bodes well for her future. The intrigue surrounding **System** lies not just in its genre but in the mystery surrounding its narrative, leaving audiences to speculate about the horrors that lurk within London's hidden depths and how Allan's character will confront them.

## What's Next

With production currently in motion for **System**, further announcements regarding its release date and more detailed plot information are expected in the coming months. In the meantime, fans can look forward to Allan's continued presence as Princess Ciri in the upcoming seasons of **The Witcher**, with Season 5 slated for an October 2026 premiere.
